Many famous people were born in Yekaterinburg. I like walking along its streets and the city pond. The weather is nice in summer. It is a modern and beautiful city. I'm proud of it.

13-s153.answer: 860+ years; seven hills; Yuri Dolgoruky, 1147; larger than London; St Petersburg — 1712

steps: heart — сердце: a heart of gold, a kind heart, from the bottom of his heart; hospitable — гостеприимный; real — настоящий: real gold, a real man; really — действительно; soul — душа: the heart and soul of the party.

9-s161.condition: Lesson 56, упр. 9, с. 161. Научись читать новые слова и предложения.
steps: He put his heart into his work. Hospitable people are always nice. Are these flowers real? Is it real gold? Really? He is the heart and soul of the party.

1. I've bought a new car. — Really? 2. I saw a crocodile yesterday. — Really? 3. We won the football game. — Really? 4. My little brother is very brave. — Really? 5. My uncle hunted a tiger. — Really? 6. My brother won the race and got a gold medal. — Really?
10-s161.answer: Really? — в ответ на каждое утверждение

11-s161.condition: Lesson 56, упр. 11, с. 161. Охарактеризуй мужчину (a real man).
steps: He is strong and kind. He is a real man. He is honest and proud. He is devoted and truthful. He is clever and brave. He is a real man.
11-s161.answer: strong, kind, honest, devoted, brave — a real man

12-s162.condition: Lesson 56, упр. 12, с. 162. Скажи, кто гостеприимный в твоей семье или семье друга.
steps: My mother is very hospitable. My granny is hospitable too — she always cooks a lot for guests. My friend's parents are hospitable.
12-s162.answer: My mother / granny / friend's parents are hospitable.

13-s162.condition: Lesson 56, упр. 13, с. 162. Скажи, кто был душой последней вечеринки.
steps: The last party I went to was my brother's birthday on 12 September. My brother John was the heart and soul of the party.
13-s162.answer: … was the heart and soul of the party

14-s162.condition: Lesson 56, упр. 14, с. 162. Расскажи о добрых персонажах сказок и книг.
steps: Don Quixote was kind and noble; he had a kind heart. Gulliver was strong and devoted. Kolobok was kind and clever. Cinderella was kind and honest; she had a heart of gold. Ivan Tsarevich was brave and noble.
14-s162.answer: … was kind / noble / brave; he / she had a heart of gold

steps: Слова песни: best — лучший, better — лучше, country — страна, east — восток, west — запад, north — север, south — юг, land — земля, peaceful — мирный, travel — путешествовать, world — мир. Поём.
15-s162.answer: Поём песню «Which land is the best?»

16-s163.condition: Lesson 56, упр. 16, с. 163. Прочитай тексты о Суворове и Кутузове.
steps: Суворов родился в 1730 году: благородный, честный, преданный стране; знал армейскую жизнь, любил солдат и учил их побеждать. Кутузов родился в 1745 году в Петербурге, ученик Суворова, знал языки и математику, стал генералом в 45 лет, выиграл войну 1812 года.
16-s163.answer: Suvorov (1730) — honest, noble, taught soldiers to win; Kutuzov (1745) — Suvorov's pupil, general, won the war of 1812.

17-s164.condition: Lesson 56, упр. 17, с. 164. Задай одноклассникам 10 вопросов по тексту.
steps: When was Suvorov born? Did he know army life well? Did he love his soldiers? What did he teach them? When was Kutuzov born? Where was he born? Whose pupil was he? Was he good at maths and languages? When did he become a general? What battle did he win in 1812?
17-s164.answer: 10 вопросов о Суворове и Кутузове: when, where, what, whose…

18-s164.condition: Lesson 56, упр. 18, с. 164. Расскажи, что ты узнал о Суворове.
steps: Alexander Suvorov was born in 1730. He was honest, noble and devoted to his country. He took part in many wars and won many battles because he knew army life very well. He was kind to his soldiers and taught them to be brave and to win.
18-s164.answer: 1730; honest, noble; many victories; loved his soldiers

19-s164.condition: Lesson 56, упр. 19, с. 164. Расскажи, что ты узнал о Кутузове.
steps: Mikhail Kutuzov was born in St Petersburg in 1745. He was Suvorov's pupil and was good at languages and maths. He took part in many battles and became a general at 45. In 1812 he was the head of the Russian army, fought at Borodino and helped Russia win the war against Napoleon.
19-s164.answer: 1745, St Petersburg; Suvorov's pupil; general; Borodino, 1812

20-s164.condition: Lesson 56, упр. 20, с. 164. Расскажи, что ты знаешь о других русских генералах.
steps: Georgy Zhukov was a Soviet general. He was born in a poor family in 1896. He was honest and brave. He joined the army in 1915 and became a general in 1940. He took part in the Great Patriotic War and won many battles, including the battle of Moscow. He got many medals.
20-s164.answer: Zhukov: 1896, general in 1940, won the battle of Moscow

21-s164.condition: Lesson 56, упр. 21, с. 164. Запиши 10 вопросов по тексту упр. 16.
steps: When was Suvorov born? Did he know army life well? Did he love his soldiers? What did he teach them? Was he honest? When was Kutuzov born? Where was he born? Whose pupil was he? Was he good at maths and languages? When did he become a general?

22-s164.condition: Lesson 56, упр. 22, с. 164. Напиши короткий рассказ о русском генерале.
steps: Alexander Suvorov was born in 1730. He was honest and noble and devoted to Russia. He took part in many wars and won all his battles. He was kind to his soldiers and taught them to win and to be brave. Suvorov died in 1800. Russian people remember him.
22-s164.answer: Suvorov: 1730–1800, honest, noble, never lost a battle

23-s164.condition: Lesson 56, упр. 23, с. 164. Запомни, как пишутся новые слова.
steps: heart — сердце; hospitable — гостеприимный; real — настоящий; really — действительно; soul — душа.

1-s164.condition: Review 8, упр. 1, с. 164. Назови символы России и Америки.
steps: Russian symbols: the flag with white, blue and red stripes; the birch tree. American symbols: the flag «The Stars and Stripes» with 50 stars and 13 stripes; the Statue of Liberty; the eagle.
1-s164.answer: Russia — flag, birch; USA — flag, Statue of Liberty, eagle

2-s164.condition: Review 8, упр. 2, с. 164. Сравни повседневную жизнь в Америке и России.
steps: People in both countries are friendly and kind and like to get together. Americans often have parties and «pot luck» dinners and easily meet new people. Russians are very hospitable, like to invite guests home and treat them to a lot of food.
2-s164.answer: both friendly; USA — parties, pot luck; Russia — hospitable, guests at home

3-s164.condition: Review 8, упр. 3, с. 164. Скажи, что ты знаешь о столицах России.
steps: Moscow was first mentioned in 1147 as a small settlement founded by Yuri Dolgoruky. In 1712 Peter the Great moved the capital to St Petersburg on the banks of the Neva. In 1918 Moscow became the capital again. Today Moscow is the capital with the Kremlin in its centre.
3-s164.answer: Moscow 1147; St Petersburg — capital 1712–1918; Moscow again since 1918

4-s164.condition: Review 8, упр. 4, с. 164. Расскажи, почему Россия — богатая страна.
steps: Russia is rich because its plant and animal worlds are very rich: there are many animals, birds and plants in the forests, fields and mountains. Russia is also rich in gold, silver and other minerals, in rivers and lakes.
4-s164.answer: rich nature, forests, rivers, gold, silver, minerals

5-s165.condition: Review 8, упр. 5, с. 165. Представь, что ты в городке в Канаде: расскажи о России.
steps: Russia is the largest country in the world. Moscow is its capital, an old city with the Kremlin in the centre. St Petersburg was the capital in the past; Peter the Great founded it in 1703. In 1812 Russia won the war against Napoleon. Russian people are kind, brave and hospitable. Our symbols are the white-blue-red flag and the birch tree.
5-s165.answer: the largest country; Moscow, St Petersburg; 1812; kind, brave, hospitable people; flag and birch

6-s165.condition: Review 8, упр. 6, с. 165. Выбери и быстро прочитай слова по теме «Война».
steps: kill, protect, a battle, a strong enemy, a war, a victory, an honest general, an army, noble officers.
6-s165.answer: kill, protect, battle, enemy, war, victory, general, army, officers

7-s165.condition: Review 8, упр. 7, с. 165. Прочитай текст «Русские люди» и скажи, чем и кем известна Россия.
steps: Russia is rich in forests, mountains, rivers and lakes, big cities and factories. But most of all Russia is well-known for its people — talented writers and composers: Chekhov, Tolstoy, Dostoevsky, Tchaikovsky, Glinka.
7-s165.answer: nature, cities; famous people — Chekhov, Tolstoy, Dostoevsky, Tchaikovsky, Glinka

8-s166.condition: Review 8, упр. 8, с. 166. Задайте друг другу вопросы по тексту «Русские люди».
steps: Is Russia a rich country? What is Russia rich in? Do you know the names of famous Russian people? Who wrote beautiful music? What do foreign guests think about Russian people?
8-s166.answer: Is Russia rich? Who are the famous Russians? What do guests think?

9-s166.condition: Review 8, упр. 9, с. 166. Кратко перескажи текст.
steps: Russia is a rich country with many forests, mountains, rivers, lakes and cities. It is famous for its talented people known all over the world: Chekhov, Tolstoy, Tchaikovsky, Gagarin. Russian people are open, kind and very hospitable.
9-s166.answer: rich nature; famous people; open, kind, hospitable

10-s166.condition: Review 8, упр. 10, с. 166. Напиши, что ты знаешь о России и её людях.
steps: Russia is a big and rich country. It has many forests, mountains, rivers and lakes and many beautiful cities. Russia is famous for its talented people — Chekhov, Tolstoy, Tchaikovsky, Gagarin and many others. People in Russia are open, kind and very hospitable. I love my country.
10-s166.answer: big and rich; famous people; open, kind, hospitable

project-work-7-s166.condition: Review 8, с. 166. Проект: глава 7 «Я живу в России».
steps: I Live in Russia: Moscow — the capital, the Kremlin; St Petersburg — the former capital on the Neva, founded by Peter the Great in 1703; the war of 1812 and Kutuzov; symbols — the flag and the birch tree; famous people — Pushkin, Tchaikovsky, Gagarin; Russian people are kind, brave and hospitable. Добавляем фотографии и карту.
project-work-7-s166.answer: Глава о России: столицы, история, символы, известные люди.
